name: @pipeworx/mcp-mailchimp

tools.name: mailchimp_list_audiences
tools.description: View all audiences in your account. Returns audience names, member counts, and engagement stats. Use mailchimp_get_audience for detailed settings.

_apiKey.description: Mailchimp API key (ends with -dc, e.g., abc123-us21)

count.description: Number of audiences to return (default 10, max 1000)

tools.name: mailchimp_get_audience
tools.description: Get detailed settings and stats for a specific audience. Pass the audience ID (e.g., "abc123def456"). Returns name, member count, engagement metrics, and configuration.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_campaigns
tools.description: View all email campaigns. Returns title, type (e.g., "regular", "automation"), status, and send timestamps. Use mailchimp_get_campaign for full details.

count.description: Number of campaigns to return (default 10, max 1000)

status.description: Filter by status: save, paused, schedule, sending, sent

tools.name: mailchimp_get_campaign
tools.description: Get full details of a campaign by ID (e.g., "abc123def456"). Returns settings, tracking configuration, performance stats, and send history.

tools.name: mailchimp_list_members
tools.description: Get subscribers in an audience by ID (e.g., "abc123def456"). Returns email addresses, subscription status, and custom merge fields.

count.description: Number of members to return (default 10, max 1000)

status.description: Filter by status: subscribed, unsubscribed, cleaned, pending, transactional

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mailchimp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mailchimp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
